functions.name: IsChildActorNode
functions.docs: Returns true if the given SCS editor tree node is a child actor node

functions.name: IsChildActorSubtreeNode
functions.docs: Returns true if the given SCS editor tree node belongs to a child actor template

functions.name: ContainsChildActorSubtreeNode
functions.docs: Returns true if any array element belongs to a child actor template

functions.name: GetOuterChildActorComponentNode
functions.docs: Returns the child actor component root node of a child actor subtree

functions.name: IsChildActorTreeViewExpansionEnabled
functions.docs: Returns whether child actor tree view expansion is enabled in project settings

functions.name: GetProjectDefaultTreeViewVisualizationMode
functions.docs: Returns the default visualization mode for child actors in a component tree view

functions.name: GetChildActorTreeViewVisualizationMode
functions.docs:
Returns the component-specific visualization mode for the given child actor component
@param DefaultVisOverride If different than UseDefault, overrides the default ChildActorComponentTreeViewVisualizationMode from the project settings.

functions.name: ShouldExpandChildActorInTreeView
functions.signature: ShouldExpandChildActorInTreeView(Child Actor Component, Default Vis Override)
functions.docs:
Whether to expand the given child actor component in a component tree view
@param DefaultVisOverride If different than UseDefault, overrides the default ChildActorComponentTreeViewVisualizationMode from the project settings and forces child actor tree view expansion to be enabled.

functions.name: ShouldShowChildActorNodeInTreeView
functions.signature: ShouldShowChildActorNodeInTreeView(Child Actor Component, Default Vis Override)
functions.docs:
Whether the Child Actor should be shown in a component tree view for the given component
@param DefaultVisOverride If different than UseDefault, overrides the default ChildActorComponentTreeViewVisualizationMode from the project settings and forces child actor tree view expansion to be enabled.

functions.name: FillComponentContextMenuOptions
functions.docs: Populates the given menu with options for the given Child Actor component

functions.name: FillChildActorContextMenuOptions
functions.docs: Populates the given menu with additional options if the given SCS editor tree node represents a Child Actor node
